_about: The dashboard To-Do feed: a short, layman-readable daily checklist of curation work (for Sam) and engineering/pre-curation work (for Fable, the Claude session), rendered by cpl_todos.js as the 📋 To-Do button on every tab. Refreshed at every Rule-8 checkpoint alongside the session handoff (this file is the handoff distilled for the dashboard). Check-off state lives in each viewer's browser (localStorage) and resets when _as_of changes. Keep it SHORT — ≤ ~12 items; done items are deleted, not checked.
_status: SESSION 64 (Startripper) — the CPL Assistant chatbot is FIXED and answering again (it had gone dark with a 502 because it was calling a Claude model that Anthropic retired on June 15 — swapped to the current Sonnet, live now; the same fix also restored the map.rccd.edu widget). Then Sam and I mapped out a big next move: turn this assistant into a CCR/CER-grounded recommendation engine + a real-time benchmark for the coming MAP Student Portal bot, plus a gentle per-college 'what are students asking us for' demand signal surfaced on each college's CPL Landing Site. The plan is locked in a scope doc; the first build (a shared data feed) is green-lit. Two quick asks below for Sam to unblock the rest. The data/CCR + TMC + KB-portal lanes are otherwise paused and waiting — docs/session_65_handoff.md.

items.text: The CPL Assistant is working again — give it a try (ask about a credential at your college). Next, we want to ground its recommendations in our CCR/CER data so a question resolves to 'here's the credential, where it's articulated, the local course, and the adoption path for your college' — and surface a per-college demand signal on the CPL Landing Sites. Three decisions would unblock the build: (1) the MAP Student Portal's own bot — same backend or separate, and can Fable see/call it for a quality comparison? (2) how should a per-college 'student demand' panel embed in the customizable CPL Landing Site? (3) a quick pass on which MAP Custom Reports fields are public-safe vs coordinator-only vs off-limits. Full plan: the CCR/CER scope doc.

The Knowledge Base tab is LIVE — sign in with your magic link and try the ✍️ New doc composer: write or paste notes, attach a file (plain text, PDF, Word, Excel, or a screenshot), hit ✨ Polish with Claude, then 'Open in GitHub →' to commit it as yourself. Please smoke-test ALL FIVE attachment types and flag anything that throws a red error chip. One decision: keep the knowledge-base repo's copy of the portal in sync too, or treat the dashboard copy as canonical?

First Light's anonymous reflections can become a gentle weekly 'musings' digest for our private Obsidian vault (never the public site). It's READY; it just needs the service key on the cpl-knowledge-base repo. One-time step: add an Actions secret named SUPABASE_SERVICE_KEY (the same Supabase service-role key the dashboard's daily sync uses) to cpl-knowledge-base.

Pick your college on the TMC Builder tab — every TMC shows whether you already have that ADT approved (✓ Approved / ⏳ In progress / ◐ Teach-out, with control number + approval date). With 'All colleges' selected, each TMC shows how many CA colleges already have it. Spot-check a few of your college's against what you know — flag anything off (it dedupes old→new, so a replaced degree shows the new one).

✨ Suggested merges (data lane, still live): groups by the obvious keyword (Algebra, the languages, ESL, Ballet, ECE/EMT/CNA/HVAC/LVN) — divider words AND abbreviations fold. Confirm the obvious families; UNCHECK or Skip a genuine progression (units are the tell). Popup tools: '➕ Add more courses by keyword', the 🏷 'match strength' slider, title-cleanup on a different target, and a 'Completion note' box.

395 college course titles carry encoding garbage at the source. The dashboard shows them repaired with a '⚠ fix in COCI' chip; the campaign list is kb/coci_title_corrections.json — take it to the colleges when ready.

NEW priority workstream (Sam green-lit 'kick it off'): build the CPL-Assistant CCR/CER recommender per docs/kb-notes/cpl-assistant-ccr-cer-recommendation-scope.md. START with the ETL — land a slim CCR (unified_courses_data.js) + CER (credential_reference_data.js) + adoption (statewide_prescriptive.js / kb/coci_articulations.json) dataset into SHARED Supabase tables via the daily cron (no live bot change). Then M1 wires those into cpl-chat (careful redeploy of the SHARED function — capture version, verify_jwt:false, smoke 4 modes). M3 = the demand stamp (privacy ADR first). M2 (benchmark) is blocked on portal-bot access.

Verify the KB-portal attachment extractors work in a real browser. pdf.js / mammoth / SheetJS + the canvas image-downscale are browser-only — CI only covers the pure logic in composer_util.js. If Sam reports a file type erroring, the usual cause is an esm.sh path in kb-portal/app.js (ATT_LIB) — a one-line fix. Also resolve the bundle-divergence decision once Sam answers. Context: docs/kb_portal_lessons.md.

CCR data lever (SkyLion's rec, still queued): the morphological-variant pass — Medical Assisting vs Medical Assistant, the -ing/-ant/-ology family. The whole-phrase synonym map can't express a shared STEM, so scope a measured, suggestions-only pass (lemmatize/stem the title token before _sug_sig, or a targeted stem-pair map) and MEASURE regroup impact + over-merge before committing. Its own dry-run PR; cron/dispatch republishes.

On Sam's go: DRY-RUN title-lane pass 2 — `python3 kb/_auto_merge_worklist.py --pass2-title` (receipt kb/automerge_out/<date>-titlelane/). Present counts; apply only on sign-off, then re-key Supabase via the supabase-rekey workflow + dispatch. (Deferred carryover: the Z future-mint half + the per-row auto-merge revert; the member-join Jaccard 0.5→0.4 measure.)

TMC Builder follow-ups: (1) harden kb/college_short_names.json with the COCI-program aliases now in tmc/_build_college_adts.py's PROGRAM_COLLEGE_ALIASES + regen college_short_names.js; (2) ADT overlay REFRESH on a fresh COCI program extract; (3) a C-ID-discrepancy export report for the C-ID team; (4) faculty-verify the 45 draft TMCs.
